teamFindings.summary: Official final status ruled out Ben Brown, Channing Canada, Carlton Davis III, Karon Prunty and Alijah Vera-Tucker; A.J. Brown is available without a final designation. Complete bound line and secondary inventories were reviewed. Davis resolves through the supported Charles Woods/Kindle Vildor added-duty committee for a 1.2-point loss; the zero-valued OUT cases preserve the nonnegative invariant. Vera-Tucker remains fail-closed because Rouse and Pryor are already bound to separate vacancies and a whole-cluster reassignment is required to avoid duplicate credit.

Official final status ruled out Kyle Monangai and Jack Sanborn, listed T.J. Edwards doubtful and Tyrique Stevenson questionable, and left Jonah Jackson and Keyshaun Elliott without final designations. The complete bound running-back inventory and official depth evidence support Roschon Johnson for Monangai's added duties while preserving D'Andre Swift's baseline role, producing a 0.5-point loss. Sanborn's frozen healthy value is zero; doubtful/questionable cases remain fail-closed until game-day status.
